audit.method: Second-pass period coverage audit focused on technical surfaces still thin after the first gap-fill: native full-duplex speech, hybrid SSM/MoE long-context models, attention kernels, and open video-generation ecosystems.

items.title: Moshi experimental real-time voice AI
items.coverage_gap_reason: Kyutai is outside the base watchlist; Moshi is material to native audio-language modeling and full-duplex real-time dialogue.

items.title: FlashAttention-3
items.coverage_gap_reason: The base GitHub release watchlist does not provide an item-level FlashAttention-3 event; this is material inference-kernel evidence for Hopper/FP8 efficiency.

items.title: CogVideoX open video-generation series
items.coverage_gap_reason: The base Z.ai release-notes index does not itemize the August-September open CogVideoX model/weight/license lifecycle.

items.title: Jamba 1.5 Mini and Large
items.coverage_gap_reason: AI21 is outside the base watchlist; Jamba 1.5 is material to hybrid Transformer-Mamba MoE, long-context, open-weight, and quantized deployment coverage.

items.title: Meta Movie Gen
items.coverage_gap_reason: The base Meta index snapshot does not itemize Movie Gen; it is material research evidence spanning video, synchronized audio, editing, and personalization.

items.title: Hunyuan-Large open MoE model
items.coverage_gap_reason: Tencent Hunyuan is outside the base watchlist; this is material open-MoE, long-context, FP8 and inference/deployment evidence.

items.title: LTX-Video initial release
items.coverage_gap_reason: Lightricks is outside the base watchlist; LTX-Video is material to open text-to-video/image-to-video and efficient local video-generation coverage.

items.title: Mochi 1 open video model
items.coverage_gap_reason: Genmo is outside the base watchlist; the living official repository establishes the 2024 Mochi 1 open-video model and November deployment/fine-tuning milestones, while exact initial-release chronology must be resolved during Evidence review.

items.title: HunyuanVideo open model weights and inference code
items.coverage_gap_reason: Tencent Hunyuan is outside the base watchlist; this is material open video-generation, parallel inference, Diffusers integration and FP8 lifecycle evidence.
